## Non-goals

- No bulk "Update all" action; the per-row button is the only trigger (PRD section 4, DL-004).
- No server-side auto-update; the server never calls update-branch without a click (PRD section 4, DL-001).
- No rebase update method; the button always produces a merge commit (PRD section 4, DL-003).
- No header toggle for the lane; it is always on (PRD section 7, DL-010).
- Branch protection settings are not read, so the UI never explains why GitHub considers a branch out of date (PRD section 7).
- No change to conflict handling, auto-merge, CD tracing, deployments or runners (PRD section 7).

## Requirements

### REQ-detection — A scan records, for every open PR, how many commits its head branch is behind its base branch, using the GraphQL query the scan already issues and no additional HTTP request.

**Priority:** P0 · **Type:** functional · **PRD:** section 12 Integrations; DL-002

#### SC-detect-behind-count — behindBy is lifted from the compare field onto the PR object  `unit` `green`

- **Given** a GraphQL PullRequest node whose baseRef.compare reports behindBy 12 and whose baseRefName is main
- **When** classifyPullRequest normalizes the node
- **Then** the returned PR object carries behindBy 12 and baseRefName main
- **Oracle:** classifyPullRequest(node).behindBy === 12 && classifyPullRequest(node).baseRefName === "main"
- **Test doubles:** none - classifyPullRequest is a pure function over the node
- **Data:** `{"baseRefName": "main", "behindBy": 12}`
- **Test:** `test/behind-base.test.js::SC-detect-behind-count: behindBy is lifted from the compare field onto the PR object`

#### SC-detect-fork-headref — a fork PR compares against an owner-qualified head ref  `unit` `green`

- **Given** a PR whose head repository is forkowner/repo and whose head branch is feat/x while the base repository is ryabinski-labs/repo
- **When** the scan builds the compare argument for that PR
- **Then** the head ref passed to compare is the owner-qualified string forkowner:feat/x
- **Oracle:** the headRef argument sent in the GraphQL variables === "forkowner:feat/x"
- **Test doubles:** GitHub GraphQL transport replaced by a recording stub; the query builder is real
- **Data:** `{"baseRepo": "ryabinski-labs/repo", "headRefName": "feat/x", "headRepo": "forkowner/repo"}`
- **Test:** `test/behind-base.test.js::SC-detect-fork-headref: a fork PR compares against an owner-qualified head ref`

#### SC-detect-same-repo-headref — a same-repo PR compares against a bare branch name  `unit` `green`

- **Given** a PR whose head and base repositories are both ryabinski-labs/repo and whose head branch is feat/x
- **When** the scan builds the compare argument for that PR
- **Then** the head ref passed to compare is the bare string feat/x with no owner prefix
- **Oracle:** the headRef argument sent in the GraphQL variables === "feat/x"
- **Test doubles:** GitHub GraphQL transport replaced by a recording stub
- **Test:** `test/behind-base.test.js::SC-detect-same-repo-headref: a same-repo PR compares against a bare branch name`

#### SC-detect-no-extra-requests — a scan where nothing moved costs no compare request  `integration` `green`

- **Given** a PR whose base and head SHAs are unchanged since the previous scan
- **When** the compare pass runs again
- **Then** the count is answered from the cache and no request is issued
- **Oracle:** fetchBehindCounts issues exactly one batched request for an unseen SHA pair, zero for an unchanged one, and one again once the base SHA moves
- **Test doubles:** globalThis.fetch is replaced so requests can be counted; the cache is the real module-level one, reset either side
- **Test:** `test/behind-base.test.js::SC-detect-no-extra-requests: a scan where nothing moved costs no compare request`

### REQ-behind-lane — An open PR that is behind its base branch and has no merge conflict appears in the behind group and in no other pull-request group.

**Priority:** P0 · **Type:** functional · **PRD:** section 5 story S1; DL-001

#### SC-lane-status-payload — the behind lane reaches /api/status, not just groupPullRequests  `integration` `green`

- **Given** a scan whose search returns one PR and whose compare reports it nine commits behind
- **When** /api/status is requested from the real server
- **Then** the lane arrives populated in the payload and the PR is in no other lane
- **Oracle:** data.pullRequests.behind has length 1 with behindBy 9, data.summary.behindPrs is 1, and pass/noCi/fail/running/conflicts are all empty
- **Test doubles:** globalThis.fetch is stubbed; the real http server and the real scan pipeline run
- **Test:** `test/behind-base.test.js::SC-lane-status-payload: the behind lane reaches /api/status, not just groupPullRequests`

#### SC-lane-exclusive — a behind PR leaves every other lane  `unit` `green`

- **Given** an open PR with behindBy 3, hasConflict false and passing checks
- **When** groupPullRequests partitions the scanned PRs
- **Then** the PR is present in the behind group and absent from pass, noCi, fail and running
- **Oracle:** groups.behind includes the PR and none of groups.pass, groups.noCi, groups.fail, groups.running includes it
- **Test doubles:** none - groupPullRequests is a pure function over the PR list
- **Data:** `{"behindBy": 3, "hasConflict": false, "state": "pass"}`
- **Test:** `test/behind-base.test.js::SC-lane-exclusive: a behind PR leaves every other lane`

#### SC-journey-unstick — the operator finds a stuck PR and unsticks it without leaving the dashboard  `acceptance` `green`

- **Given** a dashboard served a scan in which one passing PR is 3 commits behind main and the stubbed server accepts the update
- **When** the operator opens the Out of date view, clicks Update branch on that row, and the follow-up scan reports the PR no longer behind
- **Then** the PR was visible in the lane, the update was accepted, and after the refresh the lane is empty and the PR is back in Passing CI
- **Oracle:** before the click navBehind is "1"; after the click and the follow-up scan navBehind is "0", navPass increased by 1, and exactly 1 POST to /api/pull-request/update-branch was recorded
- **Test doubles:** server stubbed at the /api/status and /api/pull-request/update-branch boundaries; the real front end runs in Playwright
- **Test:** `test/behind-base-ui.test.js::SC-journey-unstick: the operator finds a stuck PR and unsticks it without leaving the dashboard`
